message: Vector Rebel 3.2.52 beta: repeated clipped PPE labels are verified against full item details in Tour and Daily Captain.
releaseNotes: Beta release for supervised field verification. Corrects a recurrent failure when Vector lists an abbreviated PPE Name but later shows its full heading and labeled serial. Tour PPE and read-only Daily Captain use one 18-second exact pool/item, full name, type, and serial proof loop before proceeding. Wrong or ambiguous equipment still stops; only physically inspected and authorized gear may be submitted. Tested with the four documented Baldree cases and fail-closed scenarios; live operator acceptance remains pending.
